app.name: Allmaths
app.tagline: University mathematics, taught from the first idea to the exam.

home.title: Learn university mathematics, step by step
home.lead: Vectors, geometry, multivariable calculus and differential equations. Every answer is checked by a real math engine, and your progress is tracked section by section.
home.free: The whole of Module 1 (Vectors) is free.
home.feature1Text: Fractions, radicals and π. Any equivalent exact form is accepted, so √2 and two over √2 are the same answer.
home.feature2Text: Your bar moves after every section you read and every question you answer, and it is still there when you come back.
home.feature3Text: Light pages that load fast on a slow connection, with a calm layout that keeps the mathematics large and clear.

grapher.linkCopied: Link copied. Anyone who opens it sees these expressions.
grapher.linkFailed: I could not copy the link. Copy the address from the browser.
grapher.specialNote: The math engine gives the exact value whenever it can prove it. A value with ≈ has no closed form (or could not be proved) and is a decimal approximation.
grapher.title: Grapher
grapher.lead: Plot functions, curves and surfaces. Type what you want to see, drag to move, use the wheel to zoom. Any letter such as a or k becomes a slider.
grapher.helpSliders: Letters such as a, b, k become sliders: try y = a*x^2 + b.
grapher.canvasLabel: Graph of the expressions. Use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, Home to reset.
grapher.canvasLabel3d: 3D graph. Use the arrow keys to rotate, plus and minus to zoom.
grapher.controls2d: Drag to move, wheel or pinch to zoom.
grapher.controls3d: Drag to turn the picture, wheel to zoom.
grapher.curve3dHelp: Write the curve as (x(t), y(t), z(t)), t in [a, b], for example (cos(t), sin(t), t/3), t in [0, 12].
grapher.extent: Size of the picture: from -{n} to {n}

solver.title: Solver
solver.lead: Type a problem and get the answer with every step. The math engine checks the result; there is no guessing.
solver.operation: What do you want to do?
solver.tips: Write products with * (2*x), powers with ^ (x^2), functions with parentheses (sin(x)) and fractions with / ((x+1)/(x-1)).
solver.freeLeft: Free plan: {left} of {limit} solves left today
solver.upgrade: Premium has no daily limit. Ask your administrator to activate Premium for your account.

sheet.figuresNote: Figures and quick checks are in the lesson on the website.
sheet.checkOnline: Write your answers here, then type them in the lesson to have them checked and to count for your progress.

courses.title: Choose your course
courses.lead: Pick the course you want to follow. You work in one course at a time, so you can focus; you can switch later and your progress is kept.
courses.switchLead: Your progress in every course is kept. When you come back to a course you continue where you stopped.
courses.switchConfirm: Switch to "{title}"? Your progress in your current course is kept.

dashboard.continueFrom: Pick up where you left off

lesson.mathFieldNote: In the answer field, press the fraction button or type a slash to get a numerator over a denominator, and the power button to get an exponent: they appear as in print. The notes below are for the plain-text box.
